h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sangli-Miraj-Kupwad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sangli-Miraj-Kupwad

items.pText: Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad come under one municipal corporation, so a single civic order can cover gardens in three towns at once. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these public gardens, and for schools and housing societies across the area. Our factory in Vasai East is about 330 km away, which keeps road delivery within Maharashtra simple.

Sangli is known for its turmeric market and sugar factories, and Miraj for its hospitals and its sitar makers. Public gardens here are used by families from early morning walkers to children in the evening, so the equipment takes heavy, unsupervised use. Share the size of each garden and a few photos with us. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing for each site, with the safe play area clearly marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Equipment for public gardens in Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad

c: In a public garden nobody checks how the equipment is used, so pick pieces with few loose parts. Fixed climbers, slides and a
handle rough play better than delicate items. Grout every post into concrete so nothing can be shifted or lifted.

Place benches outside the safe play area so parents can watch without sitting in a swing path. Ask the garden staff to walk round the equipment each morning and report loose bolts early. The Sangli plains get less rain than the coast, but summers are hot, so keep slides out of the afternoon sun. For a Maharashtra project, see our work at

facts.value: About 330 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can one quote cover gardens in Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad?
items.a: Yes. Send us the size and photos of each garden. We prepare a separate layout drawing for each site and one combined quote that your office can review.

items.q: Which equipment lasts longest in a busy public garden?
items.a: Grouted pieces with few moving parts, such as slides, climbers and merry-go-rounds, built in galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Regular checks by the garden staff help them last longer.

items.q: Do you deliver from Vasai to Sangli by road?
items.a: Yes. The equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory, about 330 km away, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it on site.
